question: What is the meaning of water use in relation to environmental performance?
description: Water use is a critical aspect of environmental performance in construction works. The release of hazardous substances, microplastics, or radiation into air, ground water, marine or surface waters or soil, as well as faulty discharge of waste water, emission of flue gases, or faulty disposal of solid or liquid waste to the outdoor environment, can all have negative impacts on water quality and availability. Additionally, damage to the building, including damage through the transport of water-borne contaminants to the foundations of the building, can also affect water use and environmental performance. Therefore, minimizing water use and ensuring sustainable water management practices are essential for achieving good environmental performance in construction works.
